stance: Prohibit — AI-generated content is not allowed
rationale_prohibit: AI-generated code is often low-quality or contains errors;Intellectual property and licensing concerns;Difficult to verify AI-generated code quality;Community consensus to prohibit
comments:
Just for precision, AI is just a tool and therefore, is not enough to contribute efficiently to a project.

The work of a software engineer is not only coding, but understanding the code, architecture it, create simple solution to complex problem...
AI can solve the "code" issue but for the other items ... It's not that great. (especially the understanding code part... and since contributing require understanding the code first...)

I think the main problem with IA is the multiplication of "coders" who don't have any knowledge about how to do a Pull Request.

* They create a single commit PR with a shit load of modification which are a pain to review
* They sometimes don't even make sure coding style / CI tests are passing
* They don't understand the code they just submitted .... But it just "works" (IF they tested it first)

This is why, when I see a PR made by IA ... I'm really not incline to accept/review it.
